# Current algorithm helpers

This file is the development counterpart of the frozen
`stage1-2026-08-22/source-release/2helpers.Rmd`.  The frozen file remains
unchanged because it is part of the provenance of the archived n=100 results.

The current manuscript-matched numerical helpers live in `R/*.R`; this analysis
loads and calls them rather than redefining scientific functions inside an Rmd.
The required sampler identity is
`exact-poisson-info-ffbs-joint-ess-devroye-2026-08-31-v2`; the approved-road
quick-test API is `countdlm-road-benchmark-2026-09-02-v1`.

## Development loader

This loader does not launch an experiment or create output.  The quick timing
run records the exact hashes of every sourced file and records whether the
worktree is dirty.  A later formal run will require a reviewed clean commit.

```{r current-helper-loader, eval=FALSE}
countdlm_code_dir <- Sys.getenv("COUNTDLM_CODE_DIR", unset = getwd())
countdlm_code_dir <- normalizePath(
  countdlm_code_dir,
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

countdlm_r_files <- sort(list.files(
  file.path(countdlm_code_dir, "R"),
  pattern = "[.]R$",
  full.names = TRUE
))
invisible(lapply(countdlm_r_files, sys.source, envir = .GlobalEnv))

stopifnot(
  identical(
    countdlm_gmde_sampler_version,
    "exact-poisson-info-ffbs-joint-ess-devroye-2026-08-31-v2"
  ),
  identical(
    countdlm_road_benchmark_api_version,
    "countdlm-road-benchmark-2026-09-02-v1"
  )
)
```

## Old-to-current helper map

| Frozen helper or behavior | Current function or rule |
|---|---|
| `cluster_stats()` | `gmde_cluster_stats()`; preserves explicit zero rows for empty experts |
| scalar `r_tune` | `gmde_make_nb_r(S, rho)` giving `rho * pmax(S, 1)` |
| pseudo-observation `zeta / omega` | not constructed |
| automatic Cholesky jitter | `gmde_chol_spd()` fails closed without jitter |
| clipped Pólya--Gamma draws | no clipping; non-positive/non-finite draws fail |
| nested allocation loops | `gmde_allocation_log_weights()` |
| contrast-specific graph likelihood | `gmde_classifier_loglik()` from the full utility matrix |
| approved road evidence | `countdlm_road_load_approved_context()`; D-017 plus exact context and selected-ID hashes |
| ad hoc geographic sampling | fixed H=10 km, 5-by-5-by-4 road-vertex sample with seed `2026090201` |

## Exactness boundary

`devroye-exact` calls `BayesLogit::rpg.devroye()` and is the exact-production
backend.  It requires integer Pólya--Gamma shape parameters; under the current
structured-r rule, formal runs must therefore use a positive integer `rho`
(and an all-integer calibration grid).  Every realized `b = S + r` is checked
again before conversion to an integer.  The hybrid `BayesLogit::rpg()` is not
used because it switches to approximate algorithms for part of its parameter
range.  The explicit `truncated` backend exists only for non-inferential
interface and sensitivity checks; its objects carry `algorithm_exact = FALSE`.

The old rolling one-step predictor is intentionally not loaded here.  Its
single NB--Pólya--Gamma assimilation step is an approximate predictive filter,
and adding one Metropolis decision would not turn it into an exact Poisson
filter.  Prediction migration therefore remains a separate registered task.

## Current quick-test boundary

The runtime quick test keeps the costly dimensions unchanged:
`n=100`, `T=168`, `K_true=5`, `K_max=10`, rank `m=40`, and exact Devroye PG.
Only the number of MCMC transitions is shortened.  It covers five internally
matched method families: GMDE-W, GMDE-C, Euc-MDE, MoDE, and Potts-MDE.  Every
value in the provisional short Potts grid is timed separately.  The largest
integer rho in the provisional geometric grid is used for timing.

The quick run is deliberately blinded to recovery: it neither passes
`Z_true` to the sampler nor computes ARI, NMI, VI, best-permutation accuracy,
or co-clustering error.  Rho, beta, chain length, and replication count remain
provisional until the timing files are reviewed.  PNARM and AR(1) latent class
are not silently replaced: their exact upstream adapters are still unavailable,
and no package is installed automatically.
